thread:
ravi: starting Silent-Stall roll (KiteEngine v4.0.0) — staged -> canary. order: api, runtime, router, console. quick thumbs?

zoe: runtime:v4.0.0-rc2 has a new scheduling tweak that reduces latency on long sequences. pinned a canary build; will run 8k-seq probe.

kevin: router team: we have a header parsing change in console that alters legacy header format. router cannot enable header-split until console is guarded.

ravi: rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.6% for 5m OR sustained p95 +12%. if hit, rollback that service and pause the wave.

deploy-bot: /deploy kiteengine v4.0.0 --staged --owners @ravi,@zoe,@kevin --order api,runtime,router,console

deploy-bot: staged deploy finished: api:v4.0.0 staged OK

ravi: kicking api canary 10%

deploy-bot: canary(api) -> 10%

zoe: runtime canary -> 10% with TEMP_KV_TTL=90m

deploy-bot: canary(runtime) -> 10%

zoe: initial perf probe shows p95 -2% but a small CPU jitter on some hosts. investigating scheduler config.

kevin: console smoke shows one client getting malformed header when flag off. pushing a defensive guard now.

ravi: hold router and console canaries. continue api/runtime to 50% while console guard lands.

deploy-bot: canary update: api/runtime -> 50%

zoe: at 50% runtime p95 stable, cpu jitter contained to 2% of hosts. TTL bump reduced eviction spikes.

kevin: guard deployed to console staging; smoke passes 25m. will coordinate a quick data-plane shim in router to tolerate old header shape for the interim.

ravi: decision: proceed api/runtime to 100%. router will roll with shim enabled until console flips the flag GA. ops note: prefer shim over unpinning runtime to reduce rollback surface.

deploy-bot: promoting api/runtime -> 100%

kevin: enabling router shim in staging now, starting router canary 10% pointed at console guarded branch

deploy-bot: router canary -> 10%

kevin: router metrics at 10% look normal, no 5xx spikes; shim correctly normalizes legacy header. moving to 50%

deploy-bot: router -> 50%

ops-lead: reminder: log the shim as a temporary mitigation in the release notes and plan to remove it in the next minor when console GA completes.

ravi: console canary started with guard flag on. smoke clean. once router at 50% and console stable 15m, finish console -> 100% and publish release.

deploy-bot: router -> 100% ; console -> 100% ; release complete: KiteEngine v4.0.0 rolled to prod

zoe: action items: add scheduler jitter probe to preflight, and include header-compat check in automated smoke.

kevin: will schedule shim removal in next sprint.

ravi: nice job. retro 9am tomorrow. :rocket:
